Traditional imaging and cytology have insufficient sensitivity for detecting subcentimeter lesions, whereas Transformer models, leveraging self-attention mechanisms, exhibit unique advantages in global context modeling and multimodal fusion. These models have shown preliminary potential in the fields of imaging, pathological and molecular diagnosis, and prognosis prediction. However, existing studies are generally constrained by single-center, small-sample designs, limited cross-center generalizability, and a lack of prospective validation; model interpretability and the computational complexity of clinical deployment also constitute critical bottlenecks. In the future, adopting the pretraining-fine-tuning paradigm of large-scale medical foundation models, advancing pan-omics fusion and dynamic temporal modeling, and conducting prospective interventional clinical validation will be key pathways to propel Transformers from assistive tools toward core components of intelligent diagnosis and treatment for peritoneal metastasis. This paper summarizes and analyzes currently available research data, reviews the applications of Transformers in three major scenarios-imaging diagnosis, pathological and molecular subtyping, and prognosis prediction-focuses on analyzing translational bottlenecks such as data scarcity, model interpretability, and clinical deployment, and proposes corresponding solutions and future directions.</AbstractText></Abstract><AuthorList CompleteYN="Y"><Author ValidYN="Y"><LastName>Zou</LastName><ForeName>P R</ForeName><Initials>PR</Initials><AffiliationInfo><Affiliation>Department of Language="chi"><AbstractText>腹膜转移是晚期恶性肿瘤的常见表现，传统影像学和细胞学对亚厘米级病灶的检出敏感度不足，而Transformer模型凭借自注意力机制在全局上下文建模和多模态融合中展现出独特优势。该类模型在影像学、病理与分子诊断以及预后预测领域已显示出初步潜力。然而，现有研究普遍受限于单中心小样本设计、跨中心泛化能力不足和前瞻性验证的缺位，模型可解释性与临床部署的计算复杂度亦构成关键瓶颈。未来，借鉴大规模医学基础模型的预训练-微调范式、推进全组学融合与动态时序建模、开展前瞻性干预性临床验证，将是推动Transformer从辅助工具走向腹膜转移智能诊疗核心组件的关键路径。本文归纳分析了当前可获取的相关研究数据，梳理了Transformer在腹膜转移影像诊断、病理与分子分型及预后预测三大场景中的应用，重点分析了数据稀缺、模型可解释性与临床部署等转化瓶颈，并提出相应的解决方案与未来方向。.</AbstractText></OtherAbstract><CoiStatement>所有作者声明不存在利益冲突</CoiStatement></MedlineCitation><PubmedData><History><PubMedPubDate
